name: list_project_custom_environments
description:
List the custom environments of a project, optionally filtered by git branch. Custom environments are separate from the built-in Production and Preview environments.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v9/projects/{idOrName}/custom-environments --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

gitBranch.description: Fetch custom environments for a specific git branch

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
